name: Wednesday Walks
description: Every Wednesday sisters are invited to go on a walk with one another at 7:45 am. We are planning to meet in North Village behind D. Running first thing in the morning can lead to spikes in cortisol causing headaches, high blood pressure, and mood changes. Morning walks have many health benefits such as regulating one's sleep schedule, improving one's mood and decreasing anxiety, increasing energy, increasing brain function, etc. We are using this as a stress-reliever for our sisters!

name: Diamond Dash - Alpha Delta Pi Philanthropy Week
description: On October 22nd, we will have the Diamond Dash. This event is a run/walk around Furman’s lake. We are hoping to have Alpha Delta Pi alumnae come out and participate along with Furman’s campus. This event will be fundraised either by ticket sales or crowd change. We are planning to have waivers for this day. Check in will start at 2 pm. We do not believe the event will take until 6 pm but wanted to give extra time for people to socialize and take pictures, while allowing plenty of time to clean up at the end.
location: Trone Student Center Hill Courtyards 1 and 2
